name: gtm-os
description: Shared company memory for priorities, customers and follow-ups

interface.shortDescription: Shared company memory for priorities, customers and follow-ups
interface.longDescription: Keep your team's customer knowledge, decisions and follow-ups in a local company brain. Start the day with your priorities, catch up on customer updates from connected tools, capture meeting decisions, or get a brief on a company or person with links to the evidence. Organize work into contexts, connect project folders to the same brain, and open the dashboard to see where things stand. Your company files stay local unless you choose to share them.
defaultPrompt: Set up a new company brain in this folder
What should I focus on today? Show my priorities and follow-ups
What changed since last time in the contexts I have open?
Sync the latest customer updates from my connected tools
Capture the decisions and next steps from these meeting notes
Brief me on a company or person, with sources
Create a context for a new customer opportunity
Link this project folder to my existing company brain
Refresh the summaries and open the dashboard
